_comment: HB2 (spec/rules/host.md). Editor commit and selectionChange subscriptions in @input/pen-react and @input/pen-vue. Per-block state goes through the pen-dom block notifier; what remains here is editor-level. Each entry names the file, the enclosing symbol, why it subscribes to every event, and optionally closedBy, the requirement that removes it. pen/no-binding-editor-subscriptions fails an entry whose symbol no longer subscribes (I15).

entries.reason: editor-level subscription, not per block (HB2): one attribution snapshot per editor, re-read on commit.
editor-level subscription, not per block (HB2): the root block order changes only on commit; one listener per editor.
editor-level subscription, not per block (HB2): whether the document is empty, one listener per editor.
editor-level subscription, not per block (HB2): the document placeholder target is computed once per editor (W2.R5's per-editor placeholder rule), not per block.
editor-level subscription, not per block (HB2): the public selection hook returns the editor selection.
editor-level subscription, not per block (HB2): the selection toolbar repositions from the selection authority on selection and commit.
editor-level subscription, not per block (HB2): the slash menu re-derives its target on commit and selection change.
editor-level subscription, not per block (HB2): the suggestion menu re-resolves its trigger (resolveSuggestionMenuTarget) on commit and selection change.
editor-level subscription, not per block (HB2): toolbar active marks and block type follow the selection and commits.
editor-level subscription, not per block (HB2): the contextual prompt tracks its target selection through the selection authority (W3.R5 chrome rule).
editor-level subscription, not per block (HB2): the open slash menu repositions when the selection authority moves (W3.R5 chrome rule).
editor-level subscription, not per block (HB2): the open suggestion menu repositions when the selection authority moves (W3.R5 chrome rule).

Not a document-block subscription (HB2): it numbers a block of the autocomplete preview, which mounts only while a completion is visible, so the listener count follows the visible completion rather than the document.

Outside-root fallback of the public hook (HB2): inside an editor root each cell subscribes through the table block's notifier slot; only a host calling the hook with no root falls back to a commit listener that filters by the commit summary. Kept by the W2 close-out decision because the hook is public.
editor-level subscription, not per block (HB2): the root block order changes only on commit; one listener per editor.
editor-level subscription, not per block (HB2): the public selection composable returns the editor selection.
editor-level subscription, not per block (HB2): whether the document is empty, one listener per editor.
